reply.analysis: Nothing was certified exactly. The verdict is gap with bracket [455, 534]. The lower bound 455 comes from a checked independent set. The upper bound 534 comes from a checked clique cover. Both codes tried (2 in total, including family-rule (2,1) with length above 533) failed to beat the clique cover, so the perturbed K(16,4) hypothesis did not lead to a closing code. Against the baselines, the agent matches cpsat_alpha (455, not proven, 123 s). Its upper bound of 534 is much tighter than frac_cover 1800, kushagra_agent 1818 and cpsat_cover (none). Time: wall 56.6 s, but 51.1 s of that was LLM time and only 5.4 s was compute. f2_minrank_sat gave a lower bound of 454 in 1.2 s, which is faster but weaker. Nothing looks suspicious. The gap of 79 remains open.
